name: Google Ads
one_liner: Programmatic interface for managing Google Ads accounts, campaigns, and reporting.
auth_notes: Requires an OAuth 2.0 access token and a developer token in the developer-token header.
access_notes: Developer token must be approved; access levels include Explorer, Basic, and Standard. Standard access requires RMF compliance and an application review.

gate.process: Fill out the developer token application form and wait for approval.

extras.rate_limits: Basic Access allows up to 15,000 API operations per day once approved; Standard Access has unlimited daily operations.

evidence.snippet: The Google Ads API uses OAuth 2.0 for authorizing API requests.
The Google Ads API has access levels tied to the developer token and requires an application review to grant them.
Google Ads API is a gRPC API, with REST bindings.
The Google Ads API is a programmatic interface for managing Google Ads accounts and campaigns, suitable for large or complex setups.
The Google Ads API has access levels tied to the developer token and requires an application review to grant them.
- `GOOGLE_ADS_MCP_BASE_URL`: The base URL where your MCP server is accessible: this will be automatically assigned by Google Cloud Run after your first deployment.
